Acuff finished with 34 points, 14 assists and six rebounds in the 132-120 loss on the road at the Smoothie King Center. He shot 13-for-26 from the field, including 3-for-11 from 3-point range, in 40 minutes, 31 seconds as the starting point guard. The seventh overall pick became one of four teenagers in history to record at least 30 points and 10 assists in a game (19 years, 347 days), joining LeBron James, Luka Dončić and Stephon Marbury. He is the first Kings rookie to do so since Kenny Smith in 1988.
